get.description: Opens a server-sent events stream that pushes this player's new notifications and XP balance as they happen, for instant toasts. Events: `ready`, `notification` (with an `id` to send back as `Last-Event-ID` after a reconnect, so nothing is missed), `xp` (`{ totalXp }`). A comment line is sent every 25 seconds to keep the connection open. A browser's `EventSource` cannot send headers, so the token may be passed as `?access_token=`. Each player can hold up to 5 streams.

429.description: This player already has the most streams allowed open.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: A project API key, starting `gami_live_`, or `gami_test_` for a staging or development project. Keep it on your server.

endUserToken.description: A short-lived token from `POST /v1/end-user-tokens`. Safe to use in a browser.

externalId.description: Your ID for this user. Unique in the project.

rankingHidden.description: Left out of every leaderboard (a shadow ban). The user is not told.

metadata.description: Anything you stored on the user.

active.description: False once the user is deactivated. Their events are then refused.

level.description: Level number. Unique in the project.

enabled.description: Whether the level counts towards progress.

requiredXp.description: Total XP needed to reach this level. Unique in the project.

hidden.description: A secret achievement, which players do not see until they earn it.

earned.description: Whether the user has reached the first tier.

awardedAt.description: When the first tier was reached.

measures.description: What it measures, in plain words.

tier.description: Highest tier reached. 0 means none yet.

tierCount.description: How many tiers there are, counting the first.

tierName.description: Name of the tier reached, from the second tier up.

value.description: What the user has so far.

nextTarget.description: The next number to reach. Null once every tier is done.

fraction.description: How far toward the next target, from 0 to 1.

key.description: Short name that rules use to award it. Unique in the project.

enabled.description: Whether it can still be awarded.

hidden.description: A secret achievement. Players do not see it, or their progress, until they earn it.

criteria.description: How it is earned without a rule: `{ event, metric, field, window, target }`, or `{ metric: "streak", streak, target }` for a streak. Null when only rules and challenges grant it.

tiers.description: Higher levels after the first, each with a `name`, a `target` above the one before, and optional `xp` given on reaching it.

eventId.description: The event that led to the award, if any.

ruleExecutionId.description: The rule run that gave the award, if any.

metadata.description: Extra details saved with the award.

key.description: Your key for the streak. Unique in the project.

triggerEvent.description: The event type that counts as activity.

cadence.description: How often a user has to be active.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for users who have none of their own.

freezeEvery.description: A freeze is earned each time the streak reaches a multiple of this. 0 means never.

maxFreezes.description: Most freezes a user can hold.

cadence.description: How often the user has to be active.

current.description: Days or weeks in a row right now. 0 once it has ended, even before their next action.

longest.description: The best the user has reached.

freezes.description: Freezes the user holds. One is spent automatically to cover a missed period.

atRisk.description: True when the user has not yet been active in the current period.

timeZone.description: The zone used to decide where a day starts for this user.

lastActivityAt.description: When the user last counted toward the streak.

freezesUsed.description: Freezes spent to cover missed periods.

brokenStreak.description: The streak that ended, for a `reset`.

key.description: Your key for the reward. Unique in the project.

currency.description: Key of the currency it costs.

perUserLimit.description: Most one person can redeem. Null means no limit.

kind.description: `code` hands out a code from a pool, and `fulfilled_by_you` leaves delivery to you, after a `reward.redeemed` webhook.

balance.description: What the user can spend now. Expired points are not counted.

expiringSoon.description: Points that expire in the next 7 days.

reward.description: The reward name at the time.

status.description: `pending` until delivered, `fulfilled` once delivered (a code is delivered at once), `cancelled` with the points refunded.

code.description: The code handed out, for a reward that uses codes.

duplicate.description: True if this idempotency key was already used, so nothing was bought again.

key.description: Your key for it, used as `?segment=`.

promote.description: How many move up from each group at the end of a season.

zone.description: Whether they are on course to move up, move down, or stay.

detail.description: More detail, such as a kudos message.

key.description: Short name for the challenge. Unique in the project.

trigger.description: The event type that counts towards it.

type.description: `counter` counts matching events. `steps` needs each step's event in order.

filters.description: Conditions an event's payload must meet to count, each `{ field, operator, value }`, for example `payload.score` greater than 80.

steps.description: For a steps challenge: the events to complete in order, each `{ name, event, filters? }`.

recurrence.description: Starts over each UTC day or week, so it can be done again. Null means it runs once.

startAt.description: When it starts. Null means it has already started.

endAt.description: When it ends. Null means it never ends.

eventId.description: The event that caused it, if any.

ruleId.description: The rule that caused it, if any.

ruleExecutionId.description: The rule run that caused it, if any.

idempotencyKey.description: The key sent to prevent duplicates, if any.

amount.description: XP added, or removed if negative.

metadata.description: Extra details saved with the change.

level.description: Current level number. Only present if the project has levels.

levelName.description: Current level name. Only present if the project has levels.

requiredXp.description: Total XP needed for this level.

event.description: What happened. Rules match this exactly.

user_id.description: Your ID for the user. A new user is created the first time an ID is seen. Leave it out for events with no user.

payload.description: Details of the event, up to 64 KB. Rule conditions can read these.

occurred_at.description: When it happened, as an ISO 8601 UTC time. Defaults to now.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe. See Avoiding duplicates. The `Idempotency-Key` header wins if both are sent.

evaluated.description: False if the rules were still running after 5 seconds. Rewards still arrive later.

achievements.description: Keys of achievements this event awarded.

totalXp.description: The user's new total. Null if the event has no user.

level.description: The user's level number. Null if the event has no user or the project has no levels.

code.description: Stable code to check in your own code.

requestId.description: Quote this when asking for help.

details.description: Which fields failed, when the request was invalid.
